O-338F8E323F9C.detail: The obligation and Acceptance require only a non-success terminal outcome. The bound RED intent additionally fails when a skipped reason is not preserved, which is an independent unbound condition.

source_recall.detail: SM-2 explicitly recalls all nine semantic case categories. Its execution-context subsection does not map the supplied active obligation IDs to its listed historical bound IDs, so it cannot independently prove the declared S7/S24 routing.

repairs.repair: Restrict the selector intent to failing only when the supplied skipped-Consumer case has a success terminal outcome. Remove the skipped-reason preservation branch unless a separate active obligation, Acceptance, and RED intent bind that behavior.
Provide an explicit source-to-current-obligation mapping before relying on the S7/S24 execution-context declarations as proof of selector ownership for these supplied IDs.
